title: Classic Dutch Lasagna
description: A twist on the Italian classic with Dutch influences. Layers of cheese and lasagna noodles are baked to perfection.

ingredients.name: Dutch cheese blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of Gouda, Edam and Havarti

ingredients.name: Citrusy tomato sauce
ingredients.notes: Made with lemon juice and zest

instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté onions and garlic until softened.
Add citrusy tomato sauce and bring to a simmer.
In a separate saucepan, melt Dutch cheese blend over low heat.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of tomato sauce.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the cheese mixture over the noodles.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the sauce, and finally the cheese.
Top with parsley and bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown.
Let rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
